title: Intermediário
description: Contar histórias, falar de experiências, hipóteses, pessoas e opiniões com fluidez.
goal: Você sustenta conversas sobre temas do dia a dia e do trabalho, explicando ideias com clareza.

units.title: Experiências e histórias
units.goal: Falar de experiências de vida e de eventos que ainda têm relação com o presente.

lessons.title: Present perfect: experiências
lessons.objective: Usar have/has + particípio para experiências sem data.
lessons.explanation:
O **present perfect** (*have/has + particípio*) fala de experiências na vida, sem indicar quando aconteceu:

- *I have visited Japan.* (já visitei o Japão)
- *Have you ever tried sushi?* (você já experimentou?)
- *She has never flown in a helicopter.* (nunca voou)

Particípios irregulares comuns: *been, done, seen, gone, written, eaten*.

key_phrases.en: Have you ever been to London?
key_phrases.pt: Você já esteve em Londres?

key_phrases.en: I have never seen that film.
key_phrases.pt: Eu nunca vi esse filme.

exercises.prompt: I ___ never ___ (eat) Thai food.
___ you ever read this book? (já)
answers: Have

exercises.prompt: Ela já trabalhou no exterior.
answers: She has worked abroad.
She has worked overseas.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: nós nunca fomos a Paris
answers: We have never been to Paris.

lessons.title: Present perfect x past simple
lessons.objective: Escolher entre present perfect e past simple.
lessons.explanation:
- **Past simple**: evento terminado, com tempo definido. *I visited Japan in 2019.*
- **Present perfect**: experiência sem tempo definido. *I have visited Japan.*

Se há *yesterday, last year, in 2019, when I was a child* → use past simple.

key_phrases.en: I lost my keys yesterday.
key_phrases.pt: Perdi minhas chaves ontem.

key_phrases.en: I have lost my keys.
key_phrases.pt: Perdi minhas chaves (e ainda não as encontrei).

exercises.prompt: I ___ to Berlin in 2018.
She has ___ (finish) the report. (particípio)
answers: finished

exercises.prompt: Eu assisti a esse filme ano passado.
answers: I watched that film last year.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

lessons.title: For, since e a duração
lessons.objective: Falar de situações que começaram no passado e continuam.
lessons.explanation:
Use **present perfect** com duração:

- **for** + período: *for three years* (por três anos)
- **since** + ponto no tempo: *since 2020* / *since Monday*

Ex.: *I have lived here for five years.* / *She has worked here since 2019.*

key_phrases.en: I have known him since school.
key_phrases.pt: Eu o conheço desde a escola.

key_phrases.en: We have been waiting for an hour.
key_phrases.pt: Estamos esperando há uma hora.

exercises.prompt: I have worked here ___ two years.
She has lived in Porto ___ 2015. (desde)
answers: since

exercises.prompt: Eu estudo inglês há três anos.
answers: I have been studying English for three years.
I have studied English for three years.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: ele mora nesta casa desde 2010
answers: He has lived in this house since 2010.

units.title: Hipóteses e probabilidade
units.goal: Falar do que aconteceria, do que pode ser verdade e de conselhos.

lessons.title: First conditional
lessons.objective: Falar de situações reais e prováveis no futuro.
lessons.explanation:
Estrutura: **if + presente simples, will + verbo base**.

- *If it rains, I will stay home.*
- *If you study, you will pass the exam.*

A cláusula com *if* pode vir antes ou depois: *I will stay home if it rains.*

key_phrases.en: If you hurry, you'll catch the train.
key_phrases.pt: Se você se apressar, vai pegar o trem.

key_phrases.en: I'll call you if I'm late.
key_phrases.pt: Eu te ligo se eu me atrasar.

exercises.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
If you eat too much, you ___ feel sick. (vai)
answers: will

exercises.prompt: Se ele chegar cedo, nós jantamos juntos.
answers: If he arrives early, we will have dinner together.
If he arrives early, we'll have dinner together.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: eu vou ficar feliz se você vier
answers: I will be happy if you come.

lessons.title: Second conditional
lessons.objective: Falar de situações imaginárias ou improváveis.
lessons.explanation:
Estrutura: **if + passado simples, would + verbo base**.

- *If I had more time, I would learn guitar.*
- *If I were you, I would apologize.* (com *were* para todas as pessoas)

key_phrases.en: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
key_phrases.pt: Se eu ganhasse na loteria, viajaria pelo mundo.

key_phrases.en: If I were you, I would talk to him.
key_phrases.pt: Se eu fosse você, falaria com ele.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ rich, I would buy a boat.
If I ___ you, I would take the job.
answers: were

exercises.prompt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo, eu viajaria mais.
answers: If I had more time, I would travel more.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct form: If she ___ here, she would help us.

lessons.title: Modal de probabilidade
lessons.explanation:
- **must** — quase certeza: *He must be tired.*
- **might / may / could** — possibilidade: *It might rain.*
- **can't** — quase impossível: *That can't be right.*

No passado: *must have + particípio* (certeza), *might have* (possibilidade).

key_phrases.en: She must be at home.
key_phrases.pt: Ela deve estar em casa.

key_phrases.en: It might be late.
key_phrases.pt: Pode ser tarde.

exercises.prompt: The lights are off. They ___ be asleep.
That ___ be true! (é impossível)
answers: can't
cannot

exercises.prompt: Ele pode estar no trabalho agora.
answers: He might be at work now.
He may be at work now.
He could be at work now.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: ela deve ter perdido o ônibus
answers: She must have missed the bus.

units.title: Ideias e conexões
units.goal: Conectar frases, descrever pessoas e coisas e usar a voz passiva.

lessons.title: Voz passiva
lessons.objective: Reconhecer e formar frases na passiva no presente e no passado.
lessons.explanation:
Passiva = **be + particípio**. O foco fica na ação, não em quem a faz:

- *The letter is written.* (presente)
- *The bridge was built in 1990.* (passado)
- *English is spoken here.*

Quem fez a ação, quando importa, vem com *by*: *The book was written by Machado.*

key_phrases.en: The house was painted last year.
key_phrases.pt: A casa foi pintada no ano passado.

key_phrases.en: Rice is grown in many countries.
key_phrases.pt: Arroz é cultivado em muitos países.

exercises.prompt: The window ___ broken yesterday.
The car is ___ (wash) every Sunday.
answers: washed

exercises.prompt: Esse livro foi escrito em 1950.
answers: This book was written in 1950.

exercises.prompt: Passive of 'They sell bread here':

lessons.title: Relative clauses: who, which, that
lessons.explanation:
- **who** — para pessoas: *The woman who called is my aunt.*
- **which** — para coisas: *The book which I bought is great.*
- **that** — para pessoas ou coisas (mais informal): *The car that I drive is old.*
- **where** — para lugares: *This is the café where we met.*

key_phrases.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
key_phrases.pt: O homem que mora ao lado é médico.

key_phrases.en: This is the place where I grew up.
key_phrases.pt: Este é o lugar onde cresci.

exercises.prompt: She is the teacher ___ helped me.
This is the hotel ___ we stayed. (lugar)
answers: where

exercises.prompt: O restaurante que recomendei é ótimo.
answers: The restaurant that I recommended is great.
The restaurant which I recommended is great.

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: o rapaz que está ali é meu primo
answers: The boy who is standing over there is my cousin.

lessons.title: Phrasal verbs essenciais
lessons.objective: Usar phrasal verbs muito comuns com sentido correto.
lessons.explanation:
Phrasal verb = verbo + partícula, com sentido próprio:

- **look for** — procurar: *I'm looking for my keys.*
- **give up** — desistir: *Don't give up!*
- **turn on / turn off** — ligar / desligar
- **pick up** — buscar / pegar: *I'll pick you up at six.*
- **find out** — descobrir: *I found out the truth.*

key_phrases.en: Turn off the lights, please.
key_phrases.pt: Apague as luzes, por favor.

key_phrases.en: I need to find out the price.
key_phrases.pt: Preciso descobrir o preço.

exercises.prompt: I'm ___ my glasses. (procurando)
Please don't ___ up. (desistir)
answers: give

exercises.prompt: Pode desligar a TV, por favor?
answers: Can you turn off the TV, please?
Could you turn off the TV, please?

exercises.prompt: Monte a frase: eu te busco às sete
answers: I'll pick you up at seven.

units.title: Trabalho e opiniões
units.goal: Expressar opiniões, concordar e discordar e relatar o que foi dito.

lessons.title: Gerúndio e infinitivo
lessons.objective: Saber quando usar -ing ou to + verbo depois de outros verbos.
lessons.explanation:
Alguns verbos pedem **-ing**: *enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, consider* (*I enjoy reading.*).

Outros pedem **to + verbo**: *want, decide, hope, plan, need* (*I decided to move.*).

Depois de preposições, use sempre **-ing**: *before leaving, thanks for helping.*

key_phrases.en: I enjoy working outdoors.
key_phrases.pt: Eu gosto de trabalhar ao ar livre.

key_phrases.en: We decided to change the plan.
key_phrases.pt: Decidimos mudar o plano.

exercises.prompt: I enjoy ___ new languages.
She decided ___ (leave) early. (to + verbo)
answers: to leave

exercises.prompt: Ele evitou falar sobre o assunto.
answers: He avoided talking about the subject.
He avoided talking about the topic.

exercises.prompt: Thank you for ___ me.

lessons.title: Reported speech
lessons.objective: Relatar o que alguém disse com o tempo verbal recuado.
lessons.explanation:
No discurso indireto, o tempo verbal costuma recuar:

- *"I am tired."* → *He said (that) he was tired.*
- *"I will call."* → *She said she would call.*
- *"I have finished."* → *They said they had finished.*

Perguntas: *"Where do you live?"* → *She asked where I lived.*

key_phrases.en: He said he was busy.
key_phrases.pt: Ele disse que estava ocupado.

key_phrases.en: She asked me where I worked.
key_phrases.pt: Ela me perguntou onde eu trabalhava.

exercises.prompt: 'I am happy.' → She said she ___ happy.
'I will come.' → He said he ___ come. (would)
answers: would

exercises.prompt: Ela disse que tinha perdido o trem.
answers: She said she had missed the train.
She said that she had missed the train.

exercises.prompt: She asked me ___ I lived.

lessons.title: Dar e discutir opiniões
lessons.objective: Usar expressões para opinar, concordar e discordar com educação.
lessons.explanation:
- Opinar: *In my opinion...* / *I think / I believe...*
- Concordar: *I totally agree.* / *That's a good point.*
- Discordar com cuidado: *I see your point, but...* / *I'm not sure I agree.*
- Pedir opinião: *What do you think?*

key_phrases.en: In my opinion, it's a good idea.
key_phrases.pt: Na minha opinião, é uma boa ideia.

key_phrases.en: I see your point, but I disagree.
key_phrases.pt: Entendo seu ponto, mas discordo.

exercises.prompt: Qual expressão serve para discordar com educação?
options: I see your point, but I disagree.

exercises.prompt: ___ my opinion, the plan is too expensive.
answers: In

exercises.prompt: Concordo totalmente com você.
answers: I totally agree with you.
I completely agree with you.
I totally agree.

exercises.prompt: Monte a pergunta: o que você acha disso
answers: What do you think about it?
